subject.title: bug: 主 Telegram session 被 lifecycleGeneration 静默重置，上下文丢失

question: Should `session.reset.idleMinutes` without `session.reset.mode: "idle"` continue to mean daily-plus-idle reset semantics, or should OpenClaw change that configuration shape to behave as idle-only for direct Telegram sessions?
rationale: The narrow restart-recovery false-positive is fixed and shipped, but the user's remaining expectation conflicts with current docs and source behavior, so automation should not change reset semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Documented Semantics
options.body: Leave modern `session.reset` blocks on daily-by-default semantics, point users who want idle-only resets to `mode: "idle"`, and close after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Add Clarifying Recovery UX
options.body: Keep runtime semantics but add doctor/docs guidance for `idleMinutes` without `mode` and stale restart-recovery metadata from older releases.

options.title: Change Config Interpretation
options.body: Treat `session.reset.idleMinutes` without `mode` as idle-only and add a compatibility/migration plan for users who relied on daily-plus-idle behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Documented Semantics
recommendation.body: Leave modern `session.reset` blocks on daily-by-default semantics, point users who want idle-only resets to `mode: "idle"`, and close after maintainer confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is about session reset policy and restart-recovery product behavior, where recent history points to steipete as the strongest routing candidate.
